stem_book: Phosphorus pentachloride dissociates as follows, in a closed reaction vessel, PCl₅(g) ⇌ PCl₃(g) + Cl₂(g). If total pressure at equilibrium of the reaction mixture is P and degree of dissociation of PCl₅ is x, the partial pressure of PCl₃ will be (a) [x/(x+1)]P (b) [2x/(1−x)]P (c) [x/(x−1)]P (d) [x/(1−x)]P
